scenes.text: This tutorial covers Training Runs. Compare several model-training runs by overlaying curves and diffing their settings.
Open Training Runs from the Results and quality control section. Select run folders or registered training records that should be compared.
In the main configuration area, choose metrics, smoothing, grouping, checkpoint criteria, and the settings fields to display.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. compare convergence, overfitting, stability, and held-out performance rather than selecting by training loss alone.
When the workflow finishes, comparison figures and settings-difference tables identify the strongest reproducible run.
